gaming_screen.purpose: Display current Steam activity, session stats, and game deals.

layout.left_pane: 140x220: Current Game card. Large cover art placeholder, title text, 'Now Playing' badge.
layout.right_pane: 160x220: Metrics stack. Three rows. Row 1: Session Time (large digits). Row 2: Achievements progress bar. Row 3: Friends online status.

gaming_screen.motion: Digital blinking colon in session time (1Hz). Progress bar fills smoothly from 0 on page load. Soft breathing glow behind cover art.
gaming_screen.interactions: Tap right pane to toggle stats view vs recent screenshots.
gaming_screen.rendering_notes: Session time updates every second -> map to a small dirty rectangle. Cover art updates rarely.
gaming_screen.prompt: A modern gaming stat dashboard for a 320x240 landscape digital display. Dark charcoal theme with neon cyan and green accents. On the left is a vertical game cover art for a sci-fi game with a 'Now Playing' badge. On the right are digital stats including session time in large monospaced font, a progress bar for achievements, and a small friends-online indicator. UI feels cyber, sleek, and data-dense but readable.
gaming_screen.motion_prompt: The time value pulses the colon every second. The achievement progress bar illuminates from left to right easing into its current percentage.
